request.query: Hasse-Schmidt higher derivation on a polynomial algebra over a commutative ring kills scalar constants in positive multi-index degree

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.mkDerivationₗ_C",
      "informal_name": "Derivation of Constant Polynomial is Zero",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_2 : Module R A]\n  [inst_3 : Module (MvPolynomial σ R) A] (f : σ → A) (r : R), (MvPolynomial.mkDerivationₗ R f) (MvPolynomial.C r) = 0",
      "informal_description": "For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \\sigma $, function $ f : \\sigma \\to A $, and element $ r \\in R $, the derivation $ \\text{mkDerivation}_\\mathcal{l} $ applied to the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ yields zero, i.e., $ \\text{mkDerivation}_\\mathcal{l}(C(r)) = 0 $. This reflects that derivations annihilate constant polynomials.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Derivation"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero'",
      "informal_name": "Zeroth Hasse Derivative is Identity",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0) f = f",
      "informal_description": "The Hasse derivative of order zero applied to any polynomial $ f $ is equal to $ f $ itself, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "MvPolynomial.derivation_C",
      "informal_name": "Derivations Annihilate Constant Polynomials",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_2 : Module R A]\n  [inst_3 : Module (MvPolynomial σ R) A] (D : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A) (a : R), D (MvPolynomial.C a) = 0",
      "informal_description": "For any derivation $ D $ from $ R $ to the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\\sigma] $ over $ A $, and for every element $ a \\in R $, the derivation of the constant polynomial $ C(a) $ is zero, i.e., $ D(C(a)) = 0 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Derivation"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero",
      "informal_name": "Zeroth Hasse Derivative is Identity Map",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0 = LinearMap.id",
      "informal_description": "For any semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order 0 on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is the identity linear map, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $ for all polynomials $ f \\in R[X] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Polynomial.derivation_C",
      "informal_name": "Derivations Annihilate Constant Polynomials",
      "kind": "theorem",

      "informal_description": "For any derivation $ D : R[X] \\to A $ over a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any element $ a \\in R $, it holds that $ D(C(a)) = 0 $.",

items.informal_name: Derivation of Constant Polynomial is Zero
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_2 : Module R A]
  [inst_3 : Module (MvPolynomial σ R) A] (f : σ → A) (r : R), (MvPolynomial.mkDerivationₗ R f) (MvPolynomial.C r) = 0
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, function $ f : \sigma \to A $, and element $ r \in R $, the derivation $ \text{mkDerivation}_\mathcal{l} $ applied to the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ yields zero, i.e., $ \text{mkDerivation}_\mathcal{l}(C(r)) = 0 $. This reflects that derivations annihilate constant polynomials.

items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0) f = f
items.informal_description: The Hasse derivative of order zero applied to any polynomial $ f $ is equal to $ f $ itself, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $.

items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_2 : Module R A]
  [inst_3 : Module (MvPolynomial σ R) A] (D : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A) (a : R), D (MvPolynomial.C a) = 0
items.informal_description: For any derivation $ D $ from $ R $ to the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ over $ A $, and for every element $ a \in R $, the derivation of the constant polynomial $ C(a) $ is zero, i.e., $ D(C(a)) = 0 $.

items.informal_name: Zeroth Hasse Derivative is Identity Map
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0 = LinearMap.id
items.informal_description: For any semiring $ R $, the Hasse derivative of order 0 on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is the identity linear map, i.e., $ D^{(0)}(f) = f $ for all polynomials $ f \in R[X] $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_2 : Module R A]
  [inst_3 : Module (Polynomial R) A] (D : Derivation R (Polynomial R) A) (a : R), D (Polynomial.C a) = 0
items.informal_description: For any derivation $ D : R[X] \to A $ over a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any element $ a \in R $, it holds that $ D(C(a)) = 0 $.
